title: White box: testing with knowledge of the code

videos.script: Black box tests what the rule describes. This lesson opens the box and tests what the code contains. {{open}} You do not need to write code for this. You need to read it, and a tool that watches it run. {{read}} Python has one built in, called trace. It counts how many times each line executes, and marks the lines that never ran. {{trace}} Run the six cases from the last lesson under it. Six passes, and one line that never ran. The line that gives older people their discount. {{gap}} Nobody had noticed the table never tested it. The report noticed in one line. {{noticed}} So add a case at sixty-one. The line runs, every line is covered, and the test passes. {{covered}} And the defect at sixty is still there. Coverage told you what ran. It never tells you whether it was right. {{right}} Then branches and paths, where the Wednesday defect was hiding all along. {{end}}
